digest.component_or_area: Plan lifecycle intents and dependencies (ticket_plan, ticket_planner)
propositions: Lifecycle intents (bind, confirm, re-key, retire, baseline, comment-identity) must be versioned with version equal to enclosing Observation.version and perform no writes during planning
Inter-ticket dependencies (create-before-link, parent-before-child) must be explicit in TicketPlan and produce deferred plans tagged dependency_deferred when blocked
Selection, filter, mode-cap, and global safety limit decisions must be applied pre-effect with scope_deferred or safety_aborted reasons before any intent or remote effect
Ticket-sourced conditions (tombstone, index-lag, moved-key, impossible-link, partial-snapshot) must map to deterministic skipped dispositions
plan_pass must remain pure and gain intent derivation and pre-effect exclusion with reason tagging while forwarding selection/limits/mode parameters
